errors.title: Out of memory (driver or executor)
causes: collect()/toPandas() pulling all rows to the driver
executor memory too small for partition size
data skew concentrating rows on one partition

errors.title: Executor lost
causes: executor OOM killed by container manager
spot/preemptible instance reclaimed
GC pause exceeded heartbeat timeout

errors.title: Shuffle fetch failure
causes: executor lost while serving shuffle blocks
external shuffle service unavailable
too many concurrent shuffle partitions

errors.title: Task not serializable
causes: closure captures a non-serializable object (session, connection, self)
RDD/DF referenced inside a transformation

errors.title: Container killed (over memory limit)
causes: executor memory overhead underestimated for Python/Arrow
off-heap usage (PySpark, native libs) exceeded

errors.title: Path or table does not exist
causes: wrong path, bucket, or catalog namespace
table not registered in the catalog in use
case-sensitivity mismatch in table name

errors.title: Column not found
causes: typo or renamed column in source schema
schema drift between writer and reader

errors.title: GC overhead limit exceeded
causes: executor heap too small for task data
too many small partitions causing object churn

errors.title: Heartbeat timeout
causes: executor busy in a long GC or heavy task
network partition between driver and executor

errors.title: File not found during read
causes: source path missing or permissions denied
concurrent writer deleted files mid-read (enable consistent view / use commits)

errors.title: Block/data exceeds 2GB limit
causes: single partition larger than 2GB - repartition upstream
broadcast variable too large
